selection.criterion: Development only: highest median per-symbol mean net R among candidates with at least 30 trades per symbol. No candidate is called established unless at least 4/6 development symbols are profitable. Validation and holdout may reject, never retune this choice.

Development only: highest median per-symbol mean net R among candidates with at least 5 trades per symbol. The low minimum allows slow rules to be examined, never establishes statistical confidence. Need at least 4/6 profitable development symbols. Already-observed 2024 and 2025 are diagnostics, not fresh validation. Only 2026 is a new holdout.
